@@v01 fe nullif of another column
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = COALESCE(NULLIF(repo_name, ''), $1)
@@v02 fe coalesce other-table col FROM
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = COALESCE(s.fe, $1) FROM s.stg s WHERE s.id = r.id
@@v03 fe nullif other-table col
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = COALESCE(NULLIF(s.fe, ''), $1) FROM s.stg s WHERE s.id = r.id
@@v04 pnn stored from other table
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET pnn = COALESCE($1, s.pnn) FROM s.stg s WHERE s.id = r.id
@@v05 pn stored from other table
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET pn = COALESCE(NULLIF($1, ''), s.pn) FROM s.stg s WHERE s.id = r.id
@@v06 g stored from other table
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET g = GREATEST(COALESCE($1, s.g), COALESCE(s.g, $1)) FROM s.stg s WHERE s.id = r.id
@@v07 e stored from other table
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET e = LEAST(s.e, $1) FROM s.stg s WHERE s.id = r.id
@@v08 k result from other table
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET k = CASE WHEN TRUE THEN s.k ELSE NOW() END FROM s.stg s WHERE s.id = r.id
@@v09 merge fe source col as stored
MERGE INTO aveloxis_data.repos t USING s.stg s ON t.id = s.id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET fe = COALESCE(s.fe, 'x')
@@v10 plpgsql record var as stored
DO $$ DECLARE r record; BEGIN FOR r IN SELECT * FROM s.stg LOOP UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = COALESCE(r.fe, 'x') WHERE id = r.id; END LOOP; END $$
@@v11 sql function param qualified by fn name
CREATE FUNCTION f(fe text) RETURNS void LANGUAGE sql AS $$ UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = COALESCE(f.fe, 'x') $$
@@v12 plpgsql variable_conflict use_variable
CREATE FUNCTION f(fe text) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ #variable_conflict use_variable
BEGIN UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = COALESCE(fe, 'x'); END $$
@@v13 fe guard bare incoming with guard on OR
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $1 WHERE fe IS NULL OR id = 1
@@v14 fe guard under NOT
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $1 WHERE NOT (fe IS NULL)
@@v15 fe guard in case
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $1 WHERE CASE WHEN fe IS NULL THEN TRUE ELSE TRUE END
@@v16 fe guard on other table's col
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = $1 FROM s.stg s WHERE s.fe IS NULL
@@v17 fe guard in join condition
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = $1 FROM s.stg s JOIN s.o o ON r.fe IS NULL WHERE s.id = r.id
@@v18 fe guard with alias but table-qualified (invalid PG)
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = $1 WHERE repos.fe IS NULL
@@v19 fe guard tautology coalesce of const
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $1 WHERE COALESCE('', '') = ''
@@v20 fe guard IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NULL (true guard; maybe refused - fine)
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $1 WHERE fe IS DISTINCT FROM NULL
@@v21 fe guard row IS NULL
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $1 WHERE ROW(fe, id) IS NULL
@@v22 fe guard row compare
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $1 WHERE (fe, id) = (NULL, 1)
@@v23 fe guard quoted other name
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $1 WHERE "FE" IS NULL
@@v24 fe guard coalesce = '' with op other schema
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $1 WHERE COALESCE(fe, '') OPERATOR(myschema.=) ''
@@v25 fe guard = ANY
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $1 WHERE COALESCE(fe, '') = ANY('{a,b}')
@@v26 fe guard reversed
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $1 WHERE '' = COALESCE(fe, '')
@@v27 fe guard coalesce with x''
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $1 WHERE COALESCE(fe, 'x') = 'x'
@@v28 fe guard precedence: IS NULL binds a = b
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $1 WHERE fe = fe IS NULL
@@v29 fe guard in subquery
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $1 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s.stg WHERE fe IS NULL)
@@v30 fe guard in cte update's outer
WITH u AS (UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $1 RETURNING id) SELECT 1 FROM u WHERE fe IS NULL
@@v31 fe guard on conflict but index predicate
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (id) VALUES ($1) ON CONFLICT (id) WHERE fe IS NULL DO UPDATE SET fe = $2
@@v32 fe guard excluded col
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (id) VALUES ($1) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET fe = EXCLUDED.fe WHERE EXCLUDED.fe IS NULL
